# DefendableLedger

> The cracked ledger of the DefendableOS ecosystem.
> Sovereign · in-house · hash-verifiable.
> Receipts. Verdicts. Training Pairs. Deeds. Books and records.
> The language lives in the blocks.

## Canonical surfaces
- defendableledger.com — primary (Cloudflare Pages · CI-built from git push)

## Legacy / secondary
- ledger.mrdefendable.com — earlier subdomain pointer to the streetledger display
- streetledger.eth.limo — ENS-resolved IPFS gateway · vocabulary ledger

## Source
- repo: github.com/SudoSuOps/defendable-ledger

## Pages
- / — Home · the doctrine · the four rails · royal jelly tiers
- /records — Public records · receipts · verdicts · training pairs · deeds
- /verify — Client-side SHA-256 verification (paste any record or hash · WebCrypto · nothing sent to a server)

## Doctrine
Operator-grade. Books and records. Class A 5-cap. No fluff. No startup-speak. No AI hype.
Sovereign compute. In-house cooks. No external chain anchoring. Receipts first. Ring ring. To the shed.

## The five tiers (Royal Jelly)
- Apex · operator-grade ground truth
- Honey · production-ready
- Jelly · solid corpus material
- Pollen · breadth coverage
- Propolis · edge cases · repair lift

## The four rails per receipt
1. Receipt issued by DefendableRouter (deterministic · hashed · provenance-stamped)
2. Verdict issued by Tribunal · SwarmCurator-9B (4-dim rubric: accuracy · CRE judgment · format · score)
3. Training pair extracted by SwarmJelly (Royal Jelly tier routing · in-house corpus)
4. Deed recorded on DefendableLedger (append-only · hash-chained · publication batched)
